title: Using Azure DevOps Wiki as a WYSIWYG Editor for Your Static Site
summary: Azure DevOps Wiki provides a WYSIWYG editor for maintaining static site documentation while keeping content in Git, allowing non-technical contributors to write and edit docs without learning Git workflows or Markdown syntax.
key_points: Azure DevOps Wiki combines a user-friendly WYSIWYG editor with automatic Git commits behind the scenes
Consultants can write content without learning Git, branches, or Markdown syntax details
The wiki supports drag-and-drop page reordering, image pasting, and Mermaid diagrams
A build pipeline can automatically convert wiki content to static site format using docfx, triggered by commits
Use batch commits in the pipeline to avoid triggering builds for every small edit
